help: Black Scorpion has granted you access to the advanced technology of the Nullifier Mace. The signature weapon of the Bane Spider Commandos, it is not a typical clumsy mace. The Bane Mace is capable of firing a variety of energy projectiles and grenades.  It can even be modified to summon and command some or Black Scorpion's technologies.
power_short_helps: Ranged (Targeted AoE), Moderate DMG(Smashing/Energy), Foe Knockback
